_comment: Agent Skills Discovery index (Cloudflare RFC-style). Field names track the spec version; adjust when the schema version changes. Lets agentic clients discover and fetch skills on demand.

skills.name: penpot-router
skills.description: Route any Penpot request to exactly one skill or workflow.

skills.name: penpot-foundations
skills.description: Token + library foundation: primitive/semantic/component tiers, themes, infer-from-design.

skills.name: penpot-component-factory
skills.description: Components with complete, tokenized variant matrices and all interactive states.

skills.name: penpot-build-screen
skills.description: Design production-grade screens from a brief, reusing the system, section by section.

skills.name: penpot-build-from-code
skills.description: Translate app code/pages into an on-system Penpot screen bound to tokens.

skills.name: penpot-build-deck
skills.description: Slide decks from a brief: 1920x1080 slide boards, deck tokens, varied archetypes, playable View-mode flow.

skills.name: penpot-document-handoff
skills.description: Annotate a design for handoff with a hideable layer: context card, numbered pins, matching notes, tooltips.

skills.name: penpot-audit-accessibility
skills.description: WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA audit: contrast, target size, semantics, focus order.

skills.name: penpot-audit-tokens
skills.description: Token governance audit: hardcoded values, off-grid spacing, orphan/duplicate tokens.

skills.name: penpot-design-to-code-review
skills.description: Extract Penpot markup/style and report drift vs source component/Storybook.

skills.name: penpot-migrate
skills.description: Figma -> Penpot migration via an intermediate representation.

skills.name: penpot-rename-layers
skills.description: Rename layers to semantic HTML names; precondition for audits and code review.

skills.name: penpot-design-md
skills.description: Extract a portable DESIGN.md design-system spec from a Penpot file.

skills.name: kmp-router
skills.description: Route any KMP build request to exactly one skill.

skills.name: kmp-init
skills.description: Scaffold a new runnable Kotlin Multiplatform app and wire it for the kit.

skills.name: kmp-create-feature
skills.description: Create a KMP Clean Architecture feature from an OpenSpec spec and a Penpot design.

skills.name: kmp-modify-feature
skills.description: Change an existing KMP feature spec-first, from an approved OpenSpec spec delta.

skills.name: kmp-review-feature
skills.description: Audit a KMP feature against the architecture rules; consume the deterministic checker report.

skills.name: kmp-test-feature
skills.description: Generate a KMP feature's test suite in dependency order through staged subagents.

skills.name: kmp-bridge-swift
skills.description: Bridge the iOS side when an expect/actual needs real Swift behind a thin interop surface.

skills.name: kmp-using-design-system
skills.description: UI guard: reuse existing X* components and tokens; never hardcode a value or string.
